newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BA 's Ayling says EU talks making headway.
newsitem.headline: BA 's Ayling says EU talks making headway.

text.p: British Airways chief executive Robert Ayling said on Friday talks with EU regulators were moving towards a resolution of differences over BA's planned alliance with AMR Corp's American Airlines.
"We are making some headway," Ayling told reporters after a meeting with European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert.
Ayling repeated his position that failure to reach a deal by November, when the 1998 season's slots are allocated to airlines, would jeopardise the prospects for a deal.
"There's a slot conference in November and I think that if we have not got something sorted out... it would go over to next year. I think that would be quite difficult to hold together," Ayling said.
The visit takes to at least three the number of times Ayling has met Van Miert on the alliance, which was first announced in June 1996.
